adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff for packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts, the code unconditionally performs a token refresh (lines 72-88) every time the connection is constructed. Unlike other calendar services in this diff (like GoogleCalendarService, Office365CalendarService) which check token expiry before refreshing, the Salesforce implementation has no expiry check - it always calls the refresh endpoint and updates the database. This is a performance bug that adds unnecessary network calls and database writes on every operation.
